review:
Jogo Ruim em todos os aspectos. Mal otimizado, sem suporte a triplos curvos ou planos, nenhuma configuração relacionada a ângulos de tela e provavelmente não possui compatibilidade com Nvidia Surround. Realmente péssimo no aspecto visual.
FFB possui detalhes mas a física não é de um simulador e está mais voltada ao arcade. Um verdadeiro banho de agua fria para quem apostou na proposta do Game como eu. Em relação ao valor, creio que qualquer valor cobrado por esse game não vale o investimento.
Na minha opinião no estado em que se encontra o game não vale a pena mesmo que fosse distribuído de forma gratuita.

AC Evo tambem saiu horrivel mas pelo menos falaram que era early access. Agora isso aqui e no maximo uma alfa e muito mal feita. Como lancam isso como completo? Uma pena pois a car list e muito legal e na teoria tambem seria legal o modo carreira, mas nao da.
nesse momento, o jogo está péssimo graficamente. não vale a pena, quando arrumarem o gráfico e desempenho eu retorno.

Basicamente fomos enganados pela empresa e alguns influenciadores. O jogo não é como os trailers, seu gráfico no ultra é meia boca, e totalmente mal otimizado, quanto a física é ridícula. Não recomendo essa bomba!

Force feedback é muito esquisito, nao transmite a pista do jeito correto, fisica horrivel, o carro parece um disco de hockey flutuando no gelo as barreiras nao funcionam, os danos parecem do GTA SA, e a AI é a pior parte do jogo, eles seguem um trilho e nada tira eles desse trilho, performance é bem questionavel, ele usa mais CPU do que GPU, é pesado e nao é bonito, roda a 60 FPS no meu PC com tudo no maximo.

Problemas críticos:
Alto consumo da CPU pelo motivo do cálculo da física ser extremamente mal otimizado. Pesado como uma física de 720hz, porém se comporta como uma física com menos de 120hz. A cada oponente adicionado, a inconsistência no cálculo aumenta.
O tire model é muito inconsistente, independente da categoria e do carro utilizado.
A física de colisão pode acabar com sua corrida, até em uma disputa porta a porta.
As penalidades são primitivas e mal aplicadas.
IA dos oponentes andam em trilhos, não defendem posição, atropelam o adversário, e caso haja um acidente, agem como um torpedo atingindo seu alvo.

Problemas menos impactantes:
Modo carreira por si só não sustenta o interesse do single player.
Gráfico ok (não é maravilhoso). Mas o que mais importa é a performance, e sabemos que este é o grande problema.
Sons, tanto dos motores quanto de colisão, deixam a desejar.

Por ser um jogo que já lançou em sua versão definitiva, os problemas críticos são inaceitáveis, demonstra a falta de visão em reconhecer que tais problemas não deveriam nunca estarem presentes em seu lançamento.
É extremamente preocupante saber se eles reconhecerão que precisam dar muita atenção ao cálculo da

Admiro a pessoa que jogou esse jogo por mais de 30m. É muito ruim! 
O FFB não é ruim em alguns carros, mas em outros, é um desastre. Legal ter muitas opções de configurações para coisas específicas no FFB, mas deveria ter um guia in-game, e não uma imagem que você "precisa" baixar e seguir as instruções.  
Acho que os únicos pontos bons são o FFB (dependendo do carro), a variedade de pista e também a variedade de carro. 

Esse projeto de Early Access não vale a pena. Além de não ser um jogo finalizado, aumentaram o preço desse troço.

[h3][b] Feedback e Problemas Encontrados no Project Motor Racing [/b][/h3]

[*] Desempenho muito ruim.

[*] Lobby online com bugs: carros fantasmas parados aleatoriamente na pista; ao tocar neles, o jogador recebe dano.

[*] Primeira prova de divisão com bug: O jogador tende a ficar na Divisão 3, independente de terminar em primeiro ou em último, ainda que termine a prova sem erros.

[*] V-Sync não funciona, mesmo ativado nas configurações.

[*] O volante do carro não é ocultado, mesmo quando a opção está desabilitada no menu.

[*] Fechamentos inesperados (crashes) ocorrendo de forma aleatória, sem padrão aparente.

[*] (Online) Bug na tela de espera da corrida: se o jogador abrir o menu enquanto aguarda a corrida, no momento da largada o jogo o teleporta para a pista e o PMR fecha o menu sozinho e o volume do som fica baixo.


[h3][b] Resumo Geral [/b][/h3]

O Project Motor Racing é um jogo promissor e possui conteúdos muito interessantes. Se a equipe continuar cuidando de cada detalhe, corrigindo os problemas e ouvindo a comunidade que realmente se importa, o PMR tem potencial para se tornar grande.

No momento, infelizmente, o PMR ainda não está em condições de ser jogado, está

A good game with a really bad default setting.

- Change the antialias method to dlss quality, turn on frame-gen if necessary, if using amd try dlaa or fsr.
- Tune the ffb before start racing
- Tune your fov
- Use a easy car to start ex mazda mx5
- Change the day time to not have a strong sun or the game will look washed, good time example 9am.

There is a very good guidance article at the official game website.

The physics and FFB are good, the cars are not "floaty" (an LMU fanboi attack with no merit.) Those reviews which say anything different show a lack of knowledge of how to set up their wheel base for each title.

HOWEVER, the game is a DO NOT BUY.
1: The graphics are poorly optimised,
2: the user interface is a mess (it switches between gamepad and PC inputs on a whim),
3: the game leaks both RAM and GPU memory
4: no MSAA or MLAA option (TAA is utter garbage for racing simulators, MSAA is the preferred choice - old but not obsolete!),
5: badly implemented shadows,
6: badly implemented LOD,
7: badly implemented wheel options,
8: no barrel reprojection for wide screen (it takes about five minutes to add it to the final processing shader but they did not!),
9: MULTIPLAYER DOES NOT WORK AT ALL,
10: and the inclusion of "mobile" settings shows this game was never meant to be on a PC.

I am sure it will improve just in time for PMR2 to be released. Keep your money and wait for PMR2.

I really wanted to like Project Motor Racing, but in its current state, it’s impossible to recommend.

I’m running a 5070 Ti on a 49" OLED at 1440p, the game suffers from heavy stuttering and poor optimisation. For a title priced like a premium sim, this level of performance is simply unacceptable.

Visually, the game doesn’t match its price point. The graphics feel a generation behind, and definitely not on par with established sims in the same price range.

Gameplay-wise, the issues continue:

AI is inconsistent and often behaves like an early alpha.

Car physics feel undeveloped, floaty, and disconnected from the road.

Overall, the whole package feels like a beta, but for some reason priced higher than fully established sim racers.

In its current state, Project Motor Racing lacks the polish, realism, and stability expected from a full release. Maybe it will become something good down the road, but as it stands today, it’s simply not worth the asking price.

Singleplayer/Multiplayer:

Project Motor Racing clearly has potential, but at its current price point, it feels hard to justify. This is a work in progress title, and it shows. Core elements are still rough, features feel incomplete, and overall polish simply doesn’t match what’s being asked financially.

Charging a near full-price tag for a game that is still evolving is a risky move, and unfortunately, Project Motor Racing falls into that trap. This is where the developers could have taken inspiration from Kunos Simulazioni and their Early Access approach: a fairer entry price that reflects the unfinished state, builds goodwill with the community, and grows alongside player feedback.

There is something promising here. The foundations are solid, and with time, updates, and refinement, this could become a strong sim racing title. But potential alone doesn’t justify the current cost. At this price, expectations are higher — and right now, the game doesn’t meet them.

By setting the bar (and the price) this high so early, the developers may have missed the opportunity to position Project Motor Racing more attractively. A revised pricing strategy would not only make more sense for what the game currently offer

The gamepad control is the second best in any sims (right after ACRally). The wheel control (FFB) can be set-up to be good, if you spend some time setting-it up (or wait for some videos sharing the setups). The cars behave very realistically (even though the grip levels might be a bit lower than expected, but not by much). The driving experience overall is great, it is predictable, controlable and FUN. FFB – default = awful, custom = surprisingly great

Once you finally discover and tune the extra FFB menu for each car, it becomes a completely different game. With some tweaks in that per-car window the detail suddenly appears and you can read what the car is doing very clearly – for me even better than in AMS2 (and I’m a big AMS2 fan). It's been a bit of a shocking launch for PMR. The hardcore sim community are tearing it apart, and that's fair given the promises that were made leading up to launch, and the actual state the game released in. The thing is, if you're looking for a simcade that leans more toward "sim" than "cade", PMR is an excellent candidate! To me it feels a bit like a spiritual successor to the Need For Speed: Shift games. 

Played on a controller with assists on, the racing is thrilling, the visuals are good, and the single player career mode is challenging! There are some things that need fixing sooner rather than later - The AI are insane and will run you off the track if you try to overtake them on the inside of a turn; the penalty system is stupid and will penalise you every time you leave the track, even if you were having a crash or lost places; and the AI difficulty is wildly variable depending on the track and conditions. 75% AI will thrash you on some courses, and get left in your dust on others. The first two issues are already on the dev's radar, so should hopefully be resolved soon.

Positives are the roster of cars is fantastic, there is a diverse range of GT race cars to choose from and a good range of tracks. Another big positive is that this game supports private peer to peer hosted lobbies letting you easily race with your mates, I know a lot of "hardcore" Sim racers think that the concept of having fun casually is a joke but not enough games support this anymore. 

Overall I hope this game succeeds in the long-run, in the short term it's not entirely there but it's on the right track.

⭐ “Project Motor Racing”

“Project Motor Racing” hooked me from the very first moments. The online mode is a pure adrenaline rush. Racing against other players makes you push to the limit, and every corner feels like a battle for the top position. That feeling when you overtake someone in the final meters… unforgettable. The desire to win keeps pulling you back for more.

The car handling is fantastic. Every car feels different — each has its own character, weight, and behavior. My MOZA R5 works perfectly, delivering strong feedback, resistance, and a realistic driving experience. The menus are pleasant and clean, the settings are comfortable to navigate — no frustration, just smooth control. The graphics are also great, and the tracks look impressive.

Of course, there is room for improvement. VR support is missing — it would have been a dream, but the developers promised to add it later, so I’m waiting eagerly. The AI opponents in singleplayer behave strangely at times and could definitely be better. Still, this doesn’t ruin the overall experience, because the game clearly has huge potential.

I truly hope the developers won’t abandon this project and will continue improving it —

[h1]Project Motor Racing: Big Ambitions, Uneven Grip[/h1]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Hb_U07XQvxE

Project Motor Racing aims to be a serious motorsport simulator, focusing on realistic car handling, licensed tracks, and a hardcore racing feel. On paper, it sounds like a dream for sim-racing fans who enjoy fine-tuning setups and pushing cars to their limits.

In practice, the experience can feel rough. Handling isn’t always consistent, AI behavior can be unpredictable, and performance issues sometimes get in the way of clean races. You can see the effort behind the physics and track detail, but it doesn’t always translate smoothly once you’re on the asphalt.

There’s clear potential here, especially for players willing to be patient, but right now it feels more like a work in progress than a fully polished racing sim.

First the negatives:
The graphics are very good after some tweaking. Not great. Not as good as AMS2. But very good. I'm not even sure if this is a negative, but compared to all of today's sims, I get why people say this. I am fine with the graphics personally.
The AI is brutal. If you get into a small bump with them, you will usually lose a headlight or fender. I think I can learn to drive around this, however. We'll see. They aren't terrible.
The neutrals:
Force Feedback. I've heard this was terrible. I would say it is just different. You don't feel the rumble of the road when driving down the track as in other sims. I'm not even sure if this is realistic. But you do feel curbs, they are fine. When you "bump" into an AI, it is a bit violent.
Otherwise I think it's fine.
The positives:
I get to drive Limerock, which I did not see since iRacing in 2009.
I get to drive the Mustang

Bonjour à tous,
Après avoir fait mes premiers tours de piste sur le jeu, je ne partage pas le point de vue de la plupart des gens. En effet, je trouve que le jeu a énormément de potentiel et d’évolution, un peu comme Automobilista 2 à sa sortie.

Je m’explique : je pense que tous les problèmes de bugs graphiques sont dus à une sortie du jeu un ou deux mois trop tôt. Pour cela, je mettrais plutôt en cause une forte pression de l'éditeur, qui veulent sortir les jeux avant les fêtes de fin d’année, sachant que de grosses mises à jour sont prévues chez les concurrents pour le début de l’année prochaine.

Concernant le moteur graphique, je pense qu’il s’agit surtout d’un problème d’optimisation. Car si on regarde en détail, le jeu est beau : c’est simplement une question d’ajustements.

Par rapport au force feedback, celui-ci m’a fortement rappelé celui d’Automobilista 2 à sa sortie : un manque de ressenti une fois qu’on dispose d’un setup avec du matériel un peu plus haut de gamme (style volant 5 à 15 Nm). Je pense que cela peut être corrigé avec le temps. En revanche, le jeu est excellent à la manette ou avec un volant débutant (style Logitech G29, Thrustmaster T150 RS, T128, etc.).

On a quand même un arrière gout de "pas terminé" en y jouant et c'est bien dommage mais les devs n'abandonnent pas leur bébé malgré des notes steam injustes. Oui le jeu n'était pas en bon état à sa sortie. Mais il s'est quand même bien amélioré et les gens ont laissé leurs évaluations négatives alors que la plupart des problèmes ont été réglés. 
Perso il tourne en qualité max en 4K sur ma 4060ti à 120fps donc soit il n'y a plus de problèmes d'optimisations soit j'ai de la chance. 
Ce jeu ne s'adresse pas aux joueurs qui veulent de la simulation hardcore, il est entre la simcade et la simu hardcore, parfait pour débuter dans le simracing et même y trouver de la dificulté et du réalisme si on enlève les aides.

Dieses Spiel, wenn man es so nennen kann, ist eine absolute Frechheit und Enttäuschung. Es ruckelt selbst mit meinem PC (AMD Radeon 9070), hat eine Grafik von vor 15 Jahren und man sieht, dass es die Farming Simulator Engine ist die absolut undetailliert ist und verwaschene Optik hat. Die Physik der Autos ist unterirdisch und absolut unrealistisch. Die Steuerung ist generell komplett ohne Gefühl, es gibt kein richtiges Force Feedback etc. und ist damit unspielbar. Für so einen Mist gebe ich nicht einen Euro aus. Die Entwickler sollten sich schämen und das ganze gehype vorher war nur mieses Marketing um die Leute abzuzocken. Das kommt dabei raus wenn Leute die Jahrelang Farming Simulatoren entwickeln plötzlich ein Rennspiel entwickeln sollen. Das war mein letztes Spiel von dieser Marke und ich habe eine Rückerstattung beantragt.

Dear Development Team,

I am writing because the current state of Project Motor Racing is not just disappointing — it is astonishingly below the level that was promised and expected.

Graphics Quality:
The visuals look outdated in a way that is difficult to understand for a game released in 2025. Compared to competing titles, PMR feels visually years behind.

Performance and Frame Rate:
Even with modern hardware, the game struggles to maintain stable performance. Frequent frame rate drops make the experience feel rushed and unpolished.

Career Mode:
The career mode is extremely barebones, consisting mostly of simple text screens. It feels as though this feature was barely started, let alone developed into something meaningful.

Artificial Intelligence:
The AI behaves like something from 25 years ago — unpredictable, unrefined, and incapable of delivering believable racing. It is difficult to imagine how this passed internal review in its current state.

Missing Features (e.g., Pit Radio):
Key features that are standard in modern racing simulations, such as pit radio communication, are missing entirely, adding to the overall feeling of incompleteness.

Nach fast 1,5 Stunden Spielzeit und dem Testen mehrerer Fahrzeuge folgt hier meine Review zu Project Motor Racing.

[b]Fahrgefühl und Sound:[/b]
Das Fahrverhalten ist weit von gut entfernt. Selbst mit warmen Reifen fühlt sich alles schwammig an, als würde man über Seife rutschen. Fühlt sich weder nach Simulation, noch nach Arcade an. Dazu kommt, dass in manchen Außenansichten plötzlich der Cockpitsound abgespielt wird, was das ohnehin unausgereifte Gesamtbild noch verstärkt. Insgesamt wirkt weder das Handling noch das Sounddesign wirklich durchdacht oder fertig.

[b]Gegner:[/b]
Die KI der Gegner erinnert eher an das Niveau von 2010. Gegner fahren stur ihre Linie, reagieren kaum auf die Umgebung und weichen so gut wie nie aus. Stattdessen wird man abgedrängt oder die KI fährt einem einfach hinten drauf. Es wirkt tatsächlich so, als wäre die KI kaum getestet worden oder man hätte sie in diesem Zustand einfach akzeptiert nach dem Motto: "Wird schon passen." Tut es aber nicht.

As of December 16, 2025: PMR is actually a very good sim racer with lots of tracks and cars. The graphics look great even with reduced settings. With my 7900XT and 5800X, I usually get over 60 FPS in 4K using the settings from the YouTuber “A Casual Racer”. The physics feel great, and I really like the menus. Some options, like gamma, currently have to be adjusted through the driver, though. There’s still room for improvement, and I’m hoping for further updates.

I’d love to see the price lowered to an early-access level for the sake of cash flow and a broader player base. I think around €20 would be very fair for PMR at its current stage. Crossplay with console buddies is really nice, and it would be great if that stays possible in the future.

Technisch ist das Spiel eher eine solide Alpha. Anstatt das Game zum Vollpreis zu releasen hätten sie sich einen Gefallen getan es zu einer Alpha zu machen. Für mich war es OK denn ich habe es als Key geholt.

Az éjszakai fények inkább zavaróak. Elfékezés füst effekt, gumi darabok a pályán, eső.....nagyon rossz. Remélem a frissítésekkel sokkal jobb lesz, d ez egyenlőre nem az amivel szívesen játszok.

Szinte az összes szimulátort próbáltam, de egyenlőre a PMR nem ér 60 eurot egyenlőre. A garfika nem túl jó és finoman fogalmaztam(nálam nem eldősleges egyébként)m 4k ultra beállítások mellett sem mondható szépnek.  Az FFB....hát....fura...némelyik géposztályban volt, amiben megláttam pár jó dolgot, de összeségében nem tetszett az FFB. LMDH autók egyszerűen vezethetetlenek, rángatják a kormány ok nélkül, mintha valami mesterkélt dolog lenne, nem tudom. A tartalom az oké szerintem. Multi egyenlőre lassú, sokat kell várni. Egyenlőre ennyi, sajnálom...pedig vártam a játékot, reméltem kiváló lesz a beharangozások miatt, de nem. Üdv!

A grafika undorító. A sokéves PCARS2 köröket ver rá ilyen téren (és szerintem, nem csak ezen a területen). Pofátlanság volt így kiadni, ultrán nézve sincs köze a korábbi "ingame" videókhoz. Egy Assetto Rally látványvilágát meg sem közelíti, de meg merem kockáztatni, hogy a Shift 2 is szebb volt. A hangok rendben vannak, ennyi pozitívum akad azért. Az, hogy kontrollerrel irányíthatatlan, már említést sem érdemel.

Na, akkor most jött el a pillanat az értékelésre... A játék egy fos! Csak így röviden és tömören. Nem szoktam játékot rögtön az elején értékelni (kivéve, ha egyből jó), de ez felcseszte az agyamat! Megvártam az első hibajavítást, megadtam az esélyt a fejlesztőknek, de most már játszani sem tudok! MOZA R9-em van, hozzá a Pit House alkalmazás, de ahogy elindítom a játékot, egyből összeomlik a MOZA Pit House. Eddig ilyen nem volt. Sz@r volt a játék, optimalizálatlan, csúnya grafika, gagyi eső effekt, gyengus FFB, de legalább működött. A pedál beállítás zavaros, nehezen ismerte fel a SIMNET Pro pedált, a menüben nem is látszik, hogy be van-e állítva, de a pályán működik. A magyar nyelvet NEM kértem, szeretném visszaállítani angolra, de nem lehet! És nem, nem fogom a Steam-en belül átállítani, játékon belül akarok nyelvet választani, ahogy az minden rendes játékban működik. Majd ha én akarok gagyi Google fordítós magyarítást, akkor majd beteszem...

Dopo l'aggiornamento rivedo la mia recensione: il gioco ha gradi potenzialità, va pero' considerato un gioco di collegamento tra mondo pc e console, perche' per poter girare su entrambi gli ambienti deve adattarsi ai limiti delle console, non è pensabile pensare che possa gestire una fisica simulativa con una grafita top. considerato questo il gioco ha grandi potenzialità. Devono sistemare ancora l'IA delle auto perche' è ancora ingiocabile (le auto non ti vedono e ti sbattono fuori, e in modalità carriera dove ogni danno lo paghi caro è un problema). per il resto la fisica è buona, senza aiuti il gioco è molto impegnativo e realisti (per quanto possa esserlo un gioco). Gli sviluppatori hanno sbagliato e spacciarlo per gioco finito, così si sono dati la zappa sui piedi, è un ottimo gioco in eary acces, che una volta affinato sarà il riferimento per le corse in ambito corssplatform.

Hanno creato molta aspettativa, ma all'atto pratico il gioco è veramente acerbo. L'IA è imbarazzante, la grafica sul triplo monitor fa pena, ottimizzata malissimo, brutto da vedere, quello che si vede dagli specchietti sembra un gioco del 1995, il force feedbak è quasi inesistente. Facevano più bella figura a presentarlo come una Early Acces, almeno avevano una scusante. Dovrebbero rimborsare tutti quelli ci sono cascati, compreso me. Un vero disastro.

🏁 Project Motor Racing – Review 1.5.0.5  

Eccomi, mi ritrovate anche qui a lamentarmi.

Lo dico subito, e a malincuore: per me Project Motor Racing, allo stato attuale, è una mezza tragedia.
Non sono qui per fare review bombing o rovinare la festa a nessuno. Anzi, vorrei esattamente il contrario: vorrei che questo gioco uscisse da uno stato che, per prezzo e ambizioni, trovo quasi imbarazzante.

Identità del progetto

Dal punto di vista strutturale il gioco è coerente.
Contenuti, interfaccia, stile visivo, presentazione: tutto ha una stessa qualità e una stessa identità. E questo, in teoria, è un pregio.

Il problema è che quella qualità è uniforme anche dove non dovrebbe esserlo.
La coerenza qui diventa un limite: è come se tutto fosse stato livellato verso una mediocrità costante.

Controlli – Pad

Premessa: io provo sempre i giochi sia con pad che con volante.

Col pad, paradossalmente, Project Motor Racing si lascia giocare abbastanza bene. Al punto che viene spontaneo pensare che, allo stato attuale, il gioco sia stato pensato prima di tutto per quello.

C’è un bug evidente sull’animazione dello sterzo, praticamente assente, ma anche quando funzionava non

v1.5.0.1時点のレビューです。運転が難しすぎないSIM。
まずPadでの操作性はとても遊びやすく、CS機も同時発売されただけの事はあり良好。
FANATEC　CSDDでのFFBはそれなりに煮詰める手間がかかり、好みのsetを見つける必要がある。車両ごとに、それもPitでのサスペンション設定の近所にしれっと有るので分かりにくく、翻訳も雑なのですが、さわれば当然好みのフィールに近づけれます。
グラフィックはHDでは残念でQHD~4ｋならAMS2やR3Eと同等かやや良いくらいで、美しいとは言い難い。
しかし、Lister　TVR　PANOZ　が収録されており、おっさんホイホイにまんまと引っ掛かり高評価です。
近代GTやLMカーで遊ぶなら他に良いSIMが有るのでそれはそっちで乗りましょう。
この９０年代にスポットを当てた点がそもそもの製品コンセプトなのでしょうね、日本ではエンスーと言われる車種ですが、この辺の車両の挙動は遊びやすく良くできています。音の雰囲気も良い（衝突音を除く・・・）
残念な点は一部しかライセンスがとれていないためか、看板や車体リバリーのロゴがなんちゃって
今後の最適化と修正、追加コンテンツが進めばと期待はできます。まあ、発売初日の調整不足過ぎでコケたのは確かですが・・・

今後のアップデートに期待し、かつ、応援したいので、「おすすめ」にしていますが、現段階では、他人にお勧めできるものではないかと思います。
まず、車の挙動や操作性については良い感じです。タイヤの温度まで管理できて、ゲームパッドでも、LT、RTボタンを使って、アクセルやブレーキを微調整できる点は良いかと思います。（なぜか、昔ながらもグランツーリスモのボタン配置（LT、RTボタンをシフトチェンジに割り当て）にすると、一切、動作しなくなるのは減点ですが）

AIについては、他の方が仰る通り、良くないです。というより、車の挙動のリアルさに追いついていない、と言った方が正しいかもしれません。
初代グランツーリスモやグランツーリスモ2のAIも本作と似たり寄ったりです。が、本作のように苛立ちを覚えたことはありません。
何故かというと、車をぶつけられる、あるいは、ぶつけたとしても、体勢を崩すことがなかったからです。なので、ストレスはなかったし、逆に無理矢理ぶつけながら、突き進むことに、それなりの楽しさもありました。

しかし、このゲームは、ぶつけられると、体勢を大きく崩してしまいます。せめて、AIの車にぶつけられた時のペナルティーは控えめに、こちらから、ぶつけた時のペナルティーはリアルよりに、くらいにしないと、現状では、ストレスがたまってしまうと思われます。

そして、一番の問題点は「ゲーム体験の演出の乏しさ」であるかと思います。
宣伝では、キャリアモードはリアル志向のマニアックでハードなもののように紹介されていましたが、実際は、シングルレースの寄せ集めのような、低価格のレースゲームのアーケードモードのような感じです。
他のレースゲームも極端に言えば、シングルレースの寄せ集めでしかありませんが、寄せ集めと感じさせない演出で工夫されていたりします。
これだと、全く期待せずにセールで買ったWRCジェネレーションズのキャリアモードの方が、ずっと面白いです。（こちらはレーシングチームに所属しているんだなと感じさせてくれる演出やレース外の要素があり、また、万人受けしなさそうな凝り具合も良かったです）
何だか、グランツーリスモ・ポータブル（グランツーリスモ・モードが廃止されたPSPソフト）の失敗を見ているような気分です。

しかしながら、レースゲームの柱である「車の挙動」については高水準なため、あとは、アップデートで手を加えるだけで現状の評価を覆すだけのポテンシャルはあるかと思います。
なので、今後のアップデートに期待しています。
アップデートにより改善され、グラフィック・フレームレートも安定し美しいグラフィックでプレイすることが出来ます。改善の余地はありますがリリース直後でこのクオリティは満足でき且つ、将来が楽しみです。貴重な日本語対応本格的レースゲームであるため、多くの人に普及し成長することを願ってレビューします。

Это ужасный кусок программного обеспечения, а не автосимулятор.
1. В игре огромные проблемы с производительностью. Графика буквально серая и невыразительная, ничего интересного в этой графике нет, при этом игра не выдает стабильный фпс на средневысоких настройках (5070ti+14600KF). Чтобы получить хотя бы нормальную частоту кадров вам придется включать DLSS и генерацию кадров. А это сильно сказывается на плавности игры и времени отклика.
2. В игре сломанный FFB. В руле нет шин, только подвеска. Кроме этого все настройки разбросаны хаотично, что-то в меню настроек, что-то в настройках самой машины. Вам потребуется изучить гайд по этим настройкам и потом тратить часов 10-15 только на то, чтобы одну машину настроить под себя.
3. В игре явно существуют какие-то скрытые параметры. Например при скольжении машина автоматически переходит на контрруление, как будто игра настроена на геймпады, но ей плевать, что у тебя руль.
4. Физика машин категорически отличается от машины к машине. В то время, когда вам будет более менее приятно ездить на машинах GTO, вы будете плеваться от машин GT3/GTP. В GTP гибрид работает как хочет, как его "заряжать" никто не знает. TC названный в русской версии как П

Это не симулятор, это игра для тех, кто вечером хочет покатать с банкой пива в одной руке, руля второй. Физика аркадная, фидбэк сомнительный, боты слепые котята, которым без разницы на вас. Карьера унылая: заплатил взнос за гонку, проехал, заработал деньги, купил новую тачку, заплатил взнос за гонку, проехал, заработал деньги, купил новую тачку. И так по кругу. Игра, конечно, обман и развод на доллары. И вряд ли кто-то её будет исправлять. Даже меню нормальное сделать не смогли, что уж тут говорить вообще. Главное DLC побольше выпустить.

[h1]《Project Motor Racing》：速度与激情、硬核与专业，快快快，冲冲冲，难难难，干干干！！！[/h1]

这款赛车运动竞速游戏，只能用“速度与激情”、“硬核与专业”来形容。赛事上的狂飙，是速度魅力的展示；驾驶室的视角，是激情燃烧的释放；方向盘的控制，是硬核操作的掌控；第一名的拿下，是专业技术的拼搏。快、快、快！冲、冲、冲！难、难、难！干、干、干！！！警灯一开，悠哉悠哉，赶快去拿纸，蹲下就开始！！！感受风一般的自由，拉爆其它对手的发动机（当然，也有可能自己的车被人拉爆！！！）┐(￣ヮ￣)┌

[h1]前排提醒[/h1]
（1）当前版本游戏优化确实有问题，间歇性的卡顿、延迟、掉帧，加载读条也比较慢，也出现过闪退现象，不过风扇倒是没有疯转巨响，也算是一点小安慰。
（2）本作比起其它赛车游戏更加难以控制，一不小心就会冲出赛道，根本不给玩家反应时间。
希望制作组可以完善（╬￣皿￣）＝○＃（￣＃）３￣）

[h1]点燃专业赛车运动的激情[/h1]
《Project Motor Racing》这款赛车运动竞速游戏，其可以参考赛车界的F1赛事，即玩家驾驶赛车在专业的赛道上快速跑满一定圈数的比赛，然后根据单场赛事排名获得积分，最终以总积分来决出赛季名词。因此，本作赛车各方面都和F1赛事非常相似，这其中也包括了赛车本身。在游戏里的赛车驾驶，不难发现，无论是跑车样式还是方程式赛车样式，都是在高速行驶过程中依靠高抓地力来过弯的，玩家在游戏中完全看不到漂移的存在，这和那些依靠漂移玩法的赛车游戏是有着本质的区别。这种赛车驾驶的跑法，给玩家最直观的感受就是“速度”，就像观看F1赛事那般，一辆接一辆的赛车高速跑弯时候的“唰”、“唰”、“唰”，看着就非常的有激情，更别提亲自驾驶体验了，爽(oﾟ▽ﾟ)o   

[h1]狂飙专业赛车运动的速度[/h1]
基础开赛车的同学应该都知道这么一句话，“弯道快才是真的快，直线谁不会加速啊？”。本作根据赛道的设计，很明显就是直线和弯道的组合。要知道游戏中百十辆赛车，性能好的秒秒钟就把速度拉到了200+ Km/H。在拥有如此优质性能的赛车或者跑车情况下，跑个直线谁还不会踩个油门呐。然而，直线快那可不算快，压弯跑得快那才叫做真本事。保持200+ Km/H的速度在不减速的情况下，体验一下急速过弯的感觉，爽是真的爽，但是惨也是真的惨，各种跑出赛道进入到沙地、草地就不说了，迎面撞墙更是频繁的一批。看着对手赛车一辆接一辆的高速过弯不撞墙，再看看我的赛车都恨不得给撞报废了。这个时候，一恨自己手太残，二恨赛车难驾驶，嗯，重点是后者╭(╯^╰)╮

[h1]体验专业赛车运动的紧张[/h1]
本作的驾驶难度大是大了亿点点，赛车操控难是难了亿点点，但是比赛的氛围感还是很足的，紧张、刺激，亲身体验还是非常带感的，当然这个前提是玩家的车技要好，这个真没得办法避

Um RPG fantástico. Uma história competente, com um mundo muito bom e personagens maravilhosos. Night City é uma delicia de ser explorada. 
O jogo tem uma progressão muito maneira, com builds muito bem marcadas e diferenciadas. Dá pra jogar stealth, dá pra cair na porrada, dá pra ser um hacker e matar inimigos através de uma camera. Infelizmente o jogo te dá direito a só um respec. 
Meu principal ponto negativo é que tem um momento que o seu personagem basicamente vira uma máquina de matar mas precisa fingir que não é em uma cutscene, quebrando um pouco a imersão.

Apesar do lançamento terrivel, CP2077 envelheceu como vinho e é um dos grandes RPGs deste século.

Cyberpunk 2077 não foi só mais um RPG que eu joguei e segui em frente. Foi um jogo que eu realmente me envolvi, daqueles que você passa horas jogando e depois fica pensando na história, nos personagens e nas escolhas que fez.

Night City é um dos mundos mais imersivos que eu já vi em um jogo. Não só pelo visual, mas pela sensação constante de que aquele lugar é hostil, desigual e meio quebrado. Tudo ali parece funcionar contra você, e isso combina perfeitamente com a proposta do jogo. Você não é um herói salvando o mundo, você é só mais alguém tentando sobreviver nele.

Na minha primeira run eu escolhi ser nômade, e isso definiu totalmente quem o V foi pra mim. Desde o começo existe essa sensação de não pertencer, de estar sempre meio deslocado, tentando achar um lugar em meio ao caos. O romance com a Panam foi facilmente um dos pontos mais fortes da experiência. Não parece algo forçado ou jogado ali só pra ter romance. Ele cresce aos poucos, nas missões, nas conversas, nas atitudes. Dá pra sentir que existe parceria ali, confiança, cuidado.

Isso me fez criar uma ligação muito forte com o V. Não era só um personagem controlado por mim, era alguém passando por conflitos reais

You think, because the map is so expansive, that the game is always just about to open up and let you off the rails to make your own story, but it doesn't happen.  The open world is just a beautiful mirage, fascinating from astride a speeding bike, inviting you to explore its back alleys and just stumble on things to do, but nope.  It's pretty scenery and nothing more, and to the extent that you can venture away from the main story to work toward other objectives, they are little more than generic assassination/retrieval missions.  It's great, I suppose, if you just want to play a linear story and see some truly breathtaking scenery when traveling between objectives, but when I hear "open world RPG" this is not what I expect.

It is an enjoyable game. The storyline is interesting and I enjoy Johnny Silverhand's animation, scripting, and voice acting a lot. He is kind of a show stealer though -- big shocker. The depth of his character makes the other characters feel a little flat. The amount of detail the developers put into the game is mind-blowing. I can always pick out something new. Such as the different areas where the NCPD officers do their holographic crime reconstructions. 

The only bad thing is how resource heavy the game tends to be. Don't expect max resolution textures unless your packing a 16 GB VRam card and if you want good raytracing the RTX 30 series won't cut the banana.  Also remember that the fewer system resources you have the more game errors you will have. As an example let's say you are playing on a Linux system which has ~30% overhead due to the current kernel instabilities. In this instance you might experience stretched necks, random car explosions, the NCPD will possibly just assume you were trying to kill them -- and the like.

Anyway -- I don't have the most robust system around and I am rather picky about my games and I found this game to be worth every penny.

Like the Cyberware you find in Night City, your expectations for this game need to be properly calibrated in order to get the most enjoyment out of it.  What it is not is a deep RPG with an immersive world that changes according to your choices and your actions, nor is it the absolutely buggy mess that it was upon first release.  What it actually is, is an action game with light RPG character progression on top of a large and beautiful albeit kind of shallow open-world.

The gunplay itself is fine, as are the skill trees.  CD Projekt Red has never blown me away with the combat of their Witcher games, and I enjoy it here in Cyberpunk more than any of the three Witcher titles but the game really struggles to make the encounters interesting.  Other than wielding a melee weapon or a ranged weapon, there is little difference between enemies and most encounters are just waves of enemies who may take cover but rarely employ any more tactics than that.

The graphics and art design are undoubtedly the best part of the game, and if you want to play something that justifies the steep price of current graphic cards, Cyberpunk will do that for you.

• Night City is insanely immersive.
• Story and characters stick with you.
• Side quests are legit, not filler.

And then the ending rolls up like:

“Cool emotional growth. Anyway, choose your flavor of existential shrug.”

Regardless of this game's technical state over the years, both during the release and now [still is far from perfect if way more playable now], 2077 has always been a masterpiece in writing and worldbuilding, and Night City is one of the most captivating worlds I had the joy to experience, if only due to it being a dystopian hellscape where nobody is the true main character and everyone lives a hellish but glossy laissez-faire capitalism life. One of the best games I have ever played.

La historia es uno de sus puntos más fuertes: madura, oscura y muy bien escrita. Las decisiones importan, los personajes están increíblemente bien construidos y las misiones secundarias muchas veces tienen más impacto que las principales. Todo está narrado con un nivel cinematográfico impresionante.

El sistema de combate es sólido y muy versátil. Puedes jugarlo como shooter, sigilo, hacker o una mezcla de todo, y el juego realmente te deja expresarte con tu propio estilo. La progresión del personaje, los implantes y las builds hacen que cada partida se sienta diferente.

Tras todas las actualizaciones y mejoras, el juego se siente pulido, estable y muy disfrutable. Es la versión que Cyberpunk siempre prometió ser, y se nota el trabajo y el compromiso del estudio por entregar una expe

Z jednej strony dostajemy niezwykle klimatyczne Night City – miasto żyjące neonami, reklamami i historiami ludzi na marginesie futurystycznego świata. Jest w tym coś fascynującego: klimat cyberpunku, muzyka, design postaci i dzielnic, a także główne wątki fabularne potrafią naprawdę wciągnąć i budzić ciekawość, co będzie dalej. To jedna z tych gier, gdzie sam spacer ulicami i obserwowanie świata daje przyjemność.
Z drugiej strony, podczas gry można czasem odnieść wrażenie, że to tytuł nie do końca ukończony – jak bardzo rozbudowane demo. Dużo systemów wygląda świetnie na papierze, ale w praktyce są płytkie. Przykładowo braindance’y, które fabularnie są ważne i ciekawie zrealizowane wizualnie, w gameplayu mają ograniczone zastosowanie. ### Эта игра зацепила меня с самой заставки

## Сюжет

Во-первых, это, пожалуй, самый крупный проект в жанре киберпанк.
В игре скрыт продуманный лор и харизматичные персонажи, которых запоминаешь надолго.

Главный герой цепляется за любую возможность выжить и постоянно сталкивается с моральным выбором — даже в побочных квестах. Чего только стоит преступник, решивший стать брейнданс-мессией.

Судьба Ви тяжёлая: он буквально живой труп со второй личностью на борту. По мере сюжета эта личность меняется и становится лучше, и Джонни всё сложнее назвать просто эгоистичным мудаком.
Для меня концовка с Бестией — самая смиренная и честная для Джонни Сильверхенда.
Пока писал этот обзор, поймал себя на том, что вспоминаю весь их путь и даже немного растрогался.

## Геймплей

Система имплантов — один из самых интересных игровых опытов.
Ты буквально чувствуешь, как из обычного человека превращаешься в машину для убийств, для которой враги — лишь препятствие.

Можно играть по-разному:

* соло-психопат в лобовой атаке
* тихий киллер
* боевой нетраннер, стравливающий врагов и взламывающий их импланты

赛博朋克2077虽然首发灾难，但经过多个版本的修补已经可以说是一款不错的3A游戏了，虽然还是有许多小bug，但已经是瑕不掩瑜的程度了

让我沉浸至今的，是它无与伦比的“灵魂”：

顶级的中文配音与叙事：这是我玩过中文配音最顶尖的游戏，没有之一。每个角色的语气、情绪、甚至街头混混的脏话，都极其地道且富有生命力。银手强尼的暴躁与狂妄，朱迪的细腻与挣扎，都通过声音直击心灵。正因为配音如此出色，我从未跳过任何一段对话，完全沉浸在了每一段恩怨情仇里。

令人信服的赛博朋克世界：夜之城不再只是一个漂亮的布景。从巨型企业金字塔的压抑，到街头帮派文化的鲜活；从霓虹闪烁的日本街，到破败混乱的沃森区，每个角落都充满了细节与故事。走在雨中，听着新闻，看着全息广告闪烁，那种高科技、低生活的沉浸感，真的拉满了。

当然，夜之城的光影之下，裂痕依然可见：
游戏依然没有解决所有问题。某些场景的光影效果仍显奇怪，物体表面偶尔会出现不真实的过度曝光或浑浊的暗部。性能优化依然是个门槛，想要在高画质下流畅探索这座都市，对硬件的要求并不友善。此外，开放世界的“活感”仍有欠缺：道路上的NPC行为模式相对僵硬，重复度高；车辆驾驶手感更是重量级——飘忽得像在冰面滑行，除非你把它纯粹当成看风景的交通工具。

以及最大的问题，本体的主线任务真的非常的短，在所有瑕疵中，最令人扼腕的或许是本体主线剧情的明显短促与仓促感。许多铺垫好的线索和人物关系，在即将推向高潮时却戛然而止，仿佛被无形之手生生剪断。这种“腰斩”感让你在通关后久久无法释怀——我们本应拥有更丰富、更完整的史诗，而不仅仅是一个精彩却匆忙的序章。

正因如此，“往日之影”的光芒才格外耀眼：
或许是为了弥补本体的遗憾，“往日之影”DLC 展现出了近乎完整的叙事力量和扎实的内容密度。新区域狗镇氛围凝练，任务设计紧凑且充满道德困境，演出水准再上一层楼。它像是一剂强心针，不仅证明了CDPR依然擅长打造令人难忘的角色与揪心的故事，更反衬出本体主线那份未竟的遗憾。如果你因为本体的短促与瑕疵而犹豫，那么“往日之影”的优秀与完整，或许正是你回归并重新评价这一切的最佳理由。

首先如果你在因为首发灾难而犹豫何时入手，那现在就是最好的入手时机，无论是游戏性，UI还是优化，现在就是最完美的版本，此后估计也不会再有这般大更新了
我很欣赏cdpr对rpg的态度，他们热衷于以无数选择取向构建起一座叙事大厦，并且这次还有分段式自动存档，让玩家可以毫无压力的探索大厦的每一处角落。你能清晰地体会到大厦内部结构的层层嵌套，几乎每一条支线都会随你选择而产生有趣的后续任务，甚至会影响主线乃至结局的进程，主线上的选择又会对支线产生变化，而这种影响又不像jrpg一般是制作组安排好的一本道，更像让你在烹饪时添几加各种香料，最终调出你想要的味道。任务解决方法也提供了很多思路，制作组也会回应你突发奇想的一些小巧思，使我游玩过程十分享受。
战斗流派更新到现在非常丰富，且切换成本极低，我在一个周目内就可以毫无压力的玩遍所有的流派和有趣的build。载具系统现在也十分全面与人性化，我做任务90%的情况都宁可不用快速传送而是自己开车过去，疾驰在夜之城中的沉浸感属实是独一份的，可惜我真的很想玩飞行载具或者像Lucy一样用单分子线荡蛛丝。并且NCPD的通缉模式真的蛮烦人的，在城区撞倒几个电线杆就要被神秘小警车和黏人小警摩群殴了，我是觉得完全可以设计低星通缉警局交罚金或坐牢之类的，追杀至死多少有点逆天了。
[h2]接下来有严重剧透[/h2]
cdpr一贯引以为豪的剧情设计在这次依旧可以给到满分，本体的确主线过于短了，当然只是说短，缺点也仅此而已，故事是完整的且优秀的。本体的故事，自始至终绕着“自我的边界”与“存在的意义”展开，V与强尼·银手的意识共生，本就是一场最极致的身心博弈——强尼不是单纯的角色，而是一种反叛的符号，是对荒坂所代表的资本体制的极致对抗，他的偏执与狂热，本质上是对“被物化的人类”的反抗，可这份反抗又走向了另一种极端：为了推倒大厦，他可以无视雪崩下的每一片雪花，为了坚守所谓的“朋克精神”，他拒绝承认个体的脆弱与求生的本能；而被relic侵蚀后V的挣扎，是每个普通人在宏大体制下的缩影，我们都在为了活下去而妥协，为了守住自我而抗争，在意识被侵蚀的日子里，每一次呼吸都是对“存在”的证明，哪怕这份证明最终指向的是无可避免的消亡。本体里的每一个选择，都不是简单的善恶抉择，而是对生命价值的不同判断：是选择成为强尼那样的反叛者，用燃烧的生命砸向冰冷的体制，还是选择做一个平凡的求生者，在夹缝中守住最后一点自我？荒坂塔的火光，不仅烧着资本的傲慢，也烧着人类对“不朽”的执念，当永生成为一种可以被购买的商品，生命的珍贵便在数据化的过程中被消解，这才是本体最刺骨的拷问——如果生命可以被复制，那所谓的永恒，究竟是实在的一抹传奇亮色，还是荒坂库里永恒存在的形式？但我在游玩过程中也时感遗憾，炸了荒坂塔又怎样呢？高塔结局中，即使没有v的干预，荒坂集团没多久也自己走上末路了，但新的公司总是存在

Formula Legends entrega uma experiência viciante, combinando de forma equilibrada a acessibilidade de um arcade com a imersão de um simulador. O único ponto que pode decepcionar alguns é o uso de nomes genéricos para pilotos e equipes. No entanto, considerando que se trata de um projeto indie, é compreensível a ausência de licenças oficiais, e isso em nada diminui a qualidade da jogabilidade.

No geral, Formula Legends é uma grata surpresa: envolvente, bem construído e com um enorme potencial para evoluir ainda mais.

Of course there are some things that aren't perfect, but hey: we are not perfect, nor are our creations. Some tweaks here and there in the AI and the game would improve it quite a lot. Dive bombs are a death sentence and the AI will not give you space haha (All the time you have to leave a space). 

In general, if you love Formula 1® and racing, with easy controls and a good challenge, you will definitely love this game.

Really amazing game for any Formula 1 enthusiast. Even though the game is not licenced, it is full of incredible detail and it is a true loveletter to the sport. 

I still can't comprehend, that you can now experience 60 years of history of this sport, all in one fun game. From the roaring beasts of the 60s till this day's hybrids. You can experience all the famous rivalries between Lauda and Hunt, Senna and Prost, Schumacher and Häkkinen, Hamilton and Verstappen, it is all here. 

The game needs more polish. There are many minor bugs and a relatively big AI balance issue on some tracks, especially in Monaco, but nothing that could be fix in future patches. The devs are lovable and they communicate constantly with the community on their discord, something I rarely see nowadays. They already have roadmap with future content and bug fixing.

The biggest thing I would love to see is the expansion from 14 cars to 20 cars and if there would be possibility, true sandbox career mode with RnD and Driver swaps. Current Story mode is more like a campaign with missions. You have each of every 16 eras and your objective is to win a championship in every era, so not exactly a career mode.

Physics is awful, it doesn’t feel like you’re driving a car, more like a bobsleigh. And this is with the new alternative controls. 
In addition to that, the AI are really slow on some tracks and very fast on others, so it is impossible to choose a difficulty that matches you. 
And finally the engine sound is horrible. 

I really can’t recommend this game.

The graphics, art style, and design direction are delightful. This makes it especially frustrating that most of the core game mechanics are stilted, clumsy, and poorly thought out.

The AI drivers are not at all fun to race. Their complete inability to navigate high-speed corners is patched over with straight-line speed that cannot be matched by the player's car, which makes race craft inorganic and irritating. They will also frequently sit behind the player's car instead of using an alternate line and if they do manage to go side-by-side into a corner, you're sure to get elbowed right out of the way.

The steering mechanics are atrocious. They are truly, truly terrible. I've tried for over 10 hours to get a feel for it, but the steering feels unnatural and wooden. Since the cars don't appear to slip or slide at all, they will immediately follow where the front wheels are pointed without deviation. BUT, the front wheels appear to slowly turn in the direction that the joystick is pointed, so mid-corner adjustments are extremely difficult and there isn't really any sense of "life" to the cars.

The current state of the game falls somewhere between what I'd expect from an Early Release and what I'd expect from a final regular release. Might have been wise to let it cook just a little longer, but the developers are actively collecting feedback and have a road map for further improvements; I'm more than satisfied with their engagement so far.

Driving is a real challenge, especially with the Late '60s races where the story mode starts you out. Controlling the car was hard, and some of the tracks were seriously hard. If you want a bit less frustration, playing in a later era first would probably be a good idea; turning on the driving aids would also be a big help of course. So, I've played the demo extensively and done the '60s cup in the complete game. 
Is it perfect? No. Does it have issues? Oh yes, specifically:

- The AI cars definitely do nothing to avoid collisions
- Collisions themselves are a bit "sticky", you can easily get stuck into another car or be prevented from taking a corner

Don't get me wrong - as I said above, there are many things that are, let's say, sub-optimal in this game, but many people are drawing comparisons with games that are completely different categories. This is not a simulator, it's not a wheel & pedals game, it's not iRacing or Assetto Corsa.

Delicious Graphics: A pleasure for the eyes, especially the cars and scenery from the different eras.

It's not a perfect title. In some aspects, it is not yet the state of the art, and some features are missing, but the developers' commitment is to refine and add them over time.

This game fills a sweet spot for wanting to live the fantasy of being a lightning-quick F1 driver without having to commit to becoming a full-time racing sim addict. Alright, maybe that's an exaggeration, but it's still a very cool idea to have an arcade game that features F1 staples such as tyre management, pitstops and track limits.

Still, a good idea only gets you so far, and I'm glad to be able to say that the execution of this concept exceeded my expectations. While this is obviously a simplified, almost cartoon version of F1, the racing still feels like the wheel-to-wheel action you'd see in F1, where you fight your opponents corner after corner, trying to outbrake and outmaneuver them while also leaving enough space to make sure you don't both fly into a gravel trap. 

Something like screwing up your qualifying but then fighting your way to the front of the pack with balls-to-the-wall racing and clever strategy calls really makes you feel accomplished. It's something you normally only experience in more realistic games, but in Formula Legends, the gameplay is accessible enough for anyone to be able to pull this off after a few races.

A fun little arcade style racer spanning the decades from the late 60s into the 2020s. The game gets better the more familiar you are with the history of the sport, and the tracks change over the eras with Vintage, Classic and Modern eras.

The variety of the cars isn't just visual, as technology progresses, the cars become faster and grippier, with the addition of WRS and BRS in the more modern cars. Certain eras remove refuelling from pitstops as well, reflecting rule changes made in the real world.

Each era's cars are lovingly crafted based on the regulations of their respective time. I personally spend a lot of time taking screenshots and viewing the models in the in game viewer.

Take the demo out for a spin and maybe you too can fall in love with this game!

What I don’t like about the game is that there are a lot of dlcs and that most do not add anything to the game. The weather changing can be a bit annoying at sometimes since when going from wets to slicks you will slide (which I’m all for since it adds realism), however it seems like the ai is unaffected by this and you can loose a lot of positions. The crash mechanics are also a bit wonky and you lock wheels with other cars for no reason. 

Outside of that it’s a great game and I can’t agree more with what I’ve heard others say which is that this is a love letter to f1.

Le jeu est sorti en kits et comporte déjà 5 DLCs payants après moins de 3 mois d'existence (seulement des voitures, environ 1,5 euros par voiture). L'ensemble des DLCs coûtant aussi cher que le jeu, donc si vous voulez le jeu entier vous devrez payer le double. Et j'ai le sentiment que l'équipe de développement veut transformer ce jeu en cash grab et compte sortir encore de nombreux morceaux de jeu ultérieurement.
Une vraie déception. La physique gâche tout : maniabilité lourde, pas fun du tout. On s’ennuie vite, et sans multijoueur, l’intérêt tombe rapidement. Vraiment dommage.

Le jeu a l'air sympa de visu mais la maniabilité notamment sur manette gâche complètement l'expérience du jeu. Gameplay trop lourd, les F1 ne tournent pas du tout dans les virages, les AI suivent un tracé et ne freinent pas lorsque vous êtes proche ! C'est un comble pour un jeu qui se veut arcade ou est le fun ? Pas assez de niveaux de difficulté, soit c'est trop simple soit c'est trop dur (seulement 3 niveaux dans le jeu). 

Passez votre chemin et prenez un bon jeu de F1. 

Je ne recommande pas !

Le jeu a un gros potentiel. Espérons une mise à jour venant régler tout ceci sans quoi ces bolides resteront au paddock.
Faut faire une mise à jour ia catastrophique et le niveau de dificulté  est pas beaucoup mieux

Grosse déception pour moi. J’avais joué quelques heures à la démo que j’avais énormément appréciée en Time Attack, mais là… le jeu est tout bonnement injouable. En fait, soit vous vous qualifiez premier et vous atomisez vos adversaires, soit il faut réussir à passer le premier virage… Mais quel enfer, cette IA ! À chaque course et dans chaque difficulté, les 3-4 premiers passent, et le reste du peloton s’agglutine dans le mur au premier virage. Certaines IA se prennent même le mur avant d’y arriver :(

Bref, les sensations ne sont pas du tout là et c’est vraiment un coup dur ! Je n’imagine même pas le carnage avant la mise à jour de l’IA. Je vais donc demander un remboursement, et peut-être que je redonnerai sa chance au jeu dans le futur. Mais je vois déjà qu’il y en a pour plus cher de DLC que de jeu… ça aussi, ça annonce la couleur, et le jeu n’a même pas 2 mois.

Le jeu m'avais énormément hypé mais au final, je le considère presque comme un scam !

Mauvaises sensations de conduite et IA injuste même en mode NORMAL. C'est trop punitif. 

Niveau conduite, ça ne répond pas ou ça répond trop. IA complétement déséquilibrée d'un circuit à l'autre. Pour tout débloquer il faut beaucoup trop d'heures de farm et je ne suis pas un try-harder. 

Joueurs casu gardez vos €.

Et la politique de sortir DLC payant sur DLC payant, qui vous font racheter le jeu une 2ème fois pour avoir un jeu complet, ne devrait pas être admissible avec un jeu encore plein de bugs et de défauts majeurs.

Völlig klare Sache: KEINE Kaufempfehlung! Ich habe zuvor bereits die Demo gespielt gehabt als das vollwertige Spiel noch nicht erschienen war. Negatives:

1. - Das Handling: Das Handling ist grauenvoll! Stell dir vor du schaust einen Film, jedoch ist der Ton den gesamtem Film über um 1 Sekunde verzögert. Dieses Problem existiert im Spiel. Zwar nicht für den Ton, aber für deine Lenkung! Sofern du einlenkst passiert im Spiel erstmal gar nichts. Es dauert (geschätzt) etwa 1 Sekunde bis deine Lenkeingaben vom Spiel umgesetzt werden. Das wäre kein Problem, wenn alle Strecken im Spiel Kurven hätten, worauf ein Stück Gerade folgt und nicht direkt im Anschluss eine weitere Kurve. Schnelle Lenkeingaben sind durch diese Verzögerung einfach unmöglich durchzuführen. Wenn man eine schnelle links-rechts Kurve fahren wollte müsste man, also noch bevor man überhaupt den eigentlichen Punkt zum einlenken in die Rechtskurve erreicht hat und sich damit noch mitten in der Linkskurve befindet

Macht absolut kein Spaß gegen sie zu fahren, mal furchtbar langsam, auf anderen Strecken furchtbar schnell, rammen dich in einer Tour weg. In der Verbindung mit der ungenauen Steuerung ein absoluter Alptraum einen GP zu fahren. Um Spaß im Time Trial zu haben ist die Steurung auch zu schlecht. Es ist ein Dilemma. Wird refunded.

Il gioco è estremamente divertente, ma ha alcuni problemi che ne minano il divertimento.

Il sistema di guida è uno degli elementi che dà maggiormente fastidio. Nelle leghe più datate, potremmo dire quelle antecedenti agli anni 2000, si riscontra un problema piuttosto grave in fase di sterzata: è come se l'auto continuasse a percepire l'input dato dallo stick, anche se questo è stato lasciato. Questo avviene anche nelle leghe successive, ma francamente l'effetto è minore, forse complice un approccio più rapido e frenetico (ma ripeto, il problema permane).

Un altro aspetto da segnalare, riguarda il comportamento della AI. Apprezzo la sua vena "anarchica", coi piloti che tendono a commettere svariati errori, ma ho notato una problematica con tutte quelle leghe inferiori all'introduzione del ERS (BRS nel gioco). Infatti, ho notato, che la AI nelle ere passate tende ad avere un'accelerazione anomala, come se potesse sfruttare il BRS. Questo compromette drasticamente la fruizione del gioco. D'altro canto, nelle ere attuali, ho come l'impressione che il BRS si possa sfruttare anche quando non è presente alcuna tacca (non so se sia voluto o meno).

Devo dire che Formula Legends mi ha sorpreso. Non è il classico simulatore ultra realistico, ma un viaggio nostalgico attraverso la storia della Formula 1. Mi è piaciuto il modo in cui ogni epoca ha il suo stile di guida: dalle monoposto degli anni ’60 con freni quasi inesistenti, fino alle moderne power unit ibride. La varietà di vetture e livree è davvero ampia e ti fa sentire parte di un percorso storico. Certo, l’IA degli avversari non è sempre brillante (anche a livelli alti, spero ci lavorino su) e la mancanza del multiplayer pesa, ma l’atmosfera e la direzione artistica compensano molto. Per me è più una lettera d’amore alla F1 che un titolo competitivo: perfetto se vuoi divertirti e rivivere decenni di corse senza stressarti con la simulazione estrema.

Se sei un giocatore “casual” e vuoi un’esperienza di corse che non ti stressi ma ti faccia divertire, Formula Legends è davvero una chicca 🎉. È davvero molto divertente: lo stile arcade mischiato a un pizzico di simulazione lo rende perfetto per chi non vuole una guida super tecnica ma ama comunque la sfida.

La guidabilità è decisamente migliorata rispetto al lancio: i recenti update hanno reso il comportamento delle macchine più reattivo, con freni più precisi e un feeling più fluido, soprattutto nelle curve — finalmente si sente meno “jankyness”. Secondo il changelog ufficiale, il dev team (3DClouds) ha lavorato sull’IA e sull’handling per rendere le corse più naturali.

Nonostante sia un gioco indie, ha una struttura pazzesca: 16 vetture ispirate a decadi diverse, 14 circuiti storici reinventati e molte modalità (Story Mode, Time Attack, gare personalizzate) per variare. La presenza del modding (livree, caschi, sponsor) è una ciliegina super gradita.

L’atmosfera è davvero calorosa: ogni epoca ha piloti leggendari, con abilità speciali tipo esperti di pioggia o strategia in pit-stop. E la grafica? Ha un tocco retrò, ma le piste sono ben disegnate e le curve sembrano vive grazie
Una bella e personalissima panoramica sulla storia della classe motoristica più famosa e importante del mondo. Un atto d'amore

自分は１９８０年代からのF1ファンです。
このゲームは自分が期待していたものとは違っていました。　公式ゲームではないことは承知していましたが、ディフォルメされたものとはいえマシンのデザインなどイメージが大きく異なり、完全な別物と感じました。
操作感もアクセルオンで異様に不安定になったりと、どうしても馴染めません。
サーキットは最低限の雰囲気は残しつつも、レイアウトがあまりに単純化されすぎて物足りない。　マシンの操作感含めて多くの要素があまりに簡易的なものに感じる。　現在アメリカを中心にF1が例をみないほどのブームとなっているが、それに乗っただけの典型的な低予算のレースゲームという印象。
ドライバーが仮名となるのは仕方ないにしても、能力は実像が全く反映されておらずレース結果はいつも変わらないので、これまたやる気を削ぐ原因となっている。
今後オンラインの対戦モードが実装される予定のようだが、あまり期待できない。
最後に、製作者は本当にF1ファンなのか？　上記にしたようにただ昨今のF1ブームに便乗しただけなら非常に残念だ。

게임 비주얼 좋은 편이고 캐쥬얼한 그래픽을 갖고 있지만 풀옵 기준 텍스처 품질도 우수함. (아스팔트 표현 굿) 특히 1960년대부터 2020년대 F1 차량과 시대별로 다양한 서킷을 구현한 것은 다른 게임에서 찾아보기 힘든 요소임. 라이센스가 없는데, 그래서 게임만의 (실제 서킷에서 영감만 받은) 독창적인 트랙 디자인과 우스꽝스럽게 바꿔놓은 드라이버, 팀의 이름도 매력 요소라고 생각함. 다만 다음과 같은 단점이 존재하는데

1. 플래시백 기능이 없음.
2. 트랙별 난이도 일관성이 없음. (특정 트랙에서는 내가 압도적 1위, 특정 트랙에서는 내가 압도적 꼴등)
3. 차 해금하려면 스토리 모드 플레이가 필수인데, 스토리 모드에서는 페널티를 못끔. (스트레스 요소)
4. 기상 예보를 안해주고 기상 알림만 해줌. 몇 랩 안에 비올 가능성 OO% (X) / 비가 오기 시작했습니다 (O) 때문에 피트인 안하고 최대한 버티다가 비 안오는거같으면 그때서야 피트인하는 전략만 사용하게 돼서 진부함
5. 연료 시스템이 있는데 출발할 때 연료를 적게 넣고 달리는게 안돼서 전략적으로 사용할 수가 없음

[h3][b]FORMULA LEGENDS, UN HOMENAJE A LA HISTORIA DE LA FÓRMULA 1[/b][/h3]

La historia del automovilismo, y en particular de la Fórmula 1, es apasionante. La máxima categoría del motor siempre fue el escenario donde las grandes escuderías pusieron a prueba a sus mejores ingenieros, buscando llevar los límites de la velocidad un poco más allá en cada época.

En un punto medio de esas dos fórmulas se encuentra la propuesta del estudio italiano 3DClouds: Formula Legends. Una carta de amor a la historia del automovilismo que nos invita a viajar por las décadas de innovación, pasión y rivalidades de la Fórmula 1. Una experiencia más accesible que un simulador puro, pero sin abandonar del todo el realismo.

A diferencia de otros títulos basados en la categoría, Formula Legends no cuenta con licencias oficiales ni pretende tenerlas. Su estilo visual deja en claro que la apuesta va por otro lado: un homenaje al automovilismo, con reinterpretaciones poligonales y deformaciones estilizadas típicas del indie, que generan una experiencia distinta y nostálgica.

Пока не могу рекомендовать. Я очень люблю F1, гонки и все что с ними связано. Игра подкупает своим минималистичным визуалом, бодрой динамикой и потенциально интересной кампанией. Это то, на что я ориентировался при покупке игры. 
По факту будь это игрой в раннем доступе, все было бы супер. Но как релиз - это слишком сыро:
1. Нет истории как таковой. Разница между 60-ми и 2000-ми минимальна, сюжета нет. Чисто чемпионаты. Немного добавляются современные плюшки, новые виды резины, DRS и прочее и все...
2. Нет русской локализации, точнее она есть, но неофициальная и кривоватая. Кол-во текста в игре не требует коллосальных усилий для перевода.
3. Геймплей - первая гонка кажется приятной, динамичной, интересной. Потом приходит помнимание, что управление и поведение машины откровенно хромают. Можно таранить, выезжать за пределы трассы и творить прочий аркадный беспредел, но при этом неточный контроль газа или тормоза отправляет боллид в стену или неуправляемый занос, как в серьезных симах. Все таки это аркада или сим?
Я надеюсь, что этот проект будет дорабатываться и улучшаться, но пока я получил очень сомнительные эмоции, близкие к разочарованию.

Formula Legends — это тот случай, когда инди-разработчики попадают в самое сердце жанра. В целом, игра оставила исключительно положительные впечатления, и прежде всего стоит отметить ее визуальную составляющую. Разработчики проделали огромную работу: игра красиво сделана, а внимание к деталям в дизайне машинок и трасс просто поражает.

Однако настоящей изюминкой для фанатов гонок стал специфический юмор. Мне очень зашел юмор на тему имен гонщиков — это остроумная и неожиданная находка, которая добавляет проекту особый шарм. Здорово сделанные машинки и трассы не только выглядят отлично, но и создают нужный "легкий вайб" во время заездов.

Итоговое впечатление: Formula Legends — это отличный выбор. Рекомендую для фана и легкого времяпрепровождения всем, кто устал от серьезных симуляторов.

[h1] 诚意满满的“小品级游戏” [/h1]
从demo开始就关注到的一款赛车游戏，被其可爱的画风和有趣的设定给吸引到了。如今终于等来了正式版的发售。
 [h3] 【赛道】 [/h3]
虽然单单看数字上只有14条赛道，但是几乎所有的赛道都有不同的布局，从60年代到当今的布局，每一条赛道神似而不形似，但是当你跑在赛道上时，面对这个弯道你又会会心一笑。非常惊讶于制作组的功力能在规避版权的同时抓住每条赛道的不同特点并予以保留。
[h3] 【车辆】 [/h3]
最令我震惊的是从60年代开始，到70和80年代，包括了00和10前后，以及当代的赛车，每个年代都有至少两款车型，在车辆的细节和涂装上充满了诚意与致敬，包括各种有梗的车队名字。而且在车辆的手感上也有不同的区别，不同的车辆能感受到在弯道上的性能差异不同，你能开着20年代中期的地效车在蒙扎的帕拉波利卡近乎全油门的驶出弯道冲向终点。此外还有一些小细节，例如：早期的赛车只有干湿两种轮胎配方；当代的赛车可以在赛道上使用drs和ers（虽然在游戏里为了规避版权改成了其他名字）。
 [h3] 【车手】 [/h3]
不同的车手有不同的技能效果，例如在第一位时可以提升最大速度和提速，还有能提升转向和制动能力。这些有着不同能力的车手可以随着你的游玩不断解锁。然后就是这作车手的名字，各种的删减修改进行规避，但是你却能一眼看出，并且为此傻乐好久：MARLOS SAEZ，CHUCK MORRIS还有唯一指定汽车人MARK PEERSTALLEN（笑）。当然我这里只写了几位当代比较知名的车手，游戏里还包含了从60年代以来的上古大神们，这就留到游戏中自行探索。
[h3] 【驾驶手感】 [/h3]
至于你说驾驶时的手感，我只能说所见即所得，当你看到这个游戏的画风的时候你就能想象出它的手感了，在入弯的时候转向不足，但是在弯中又会转向过度，而且在过连续弯的时候时常掰不动方向导致走大。但是话说回来，为了这个题材买这个游戏的谁会在意这个问题呢，当然是选择和手感和解，默默的享受这种同自己搏斗的快乐了。不过令人捉急的是在赛事中的ai碰撞有点令人难受，在其他赛车游戏中所习惯的别车在这里派不上用场，别车的后果往往就是车仰马翻，并且ai的逻辑有点不太顺从直觉。如果在这上面犹豫的可以去试玩版中进行一个体验再做决定。

《Formula Legends》又一款赛车游戏问世，见到第一眼的时候游戏给我的感觉非常良好，从60年代至20年代的赛道地图和赛车都应有尽有，同时也在各个地图上做出了年代感区分，见证从赛车的黄金年代再步入现代二十一世纪有些让人感慨，也确实一部游戏能够包含跨越六十多年的赛车历史让不少玩家情有独钟。

作为赛车游戏首先最重要的是操作手感，操作手感能够直接影响到整部作品玩家对其的印象和喜好，但比较遗憾的是《Formula Legends》本作给我的印象并不是很好，游戏中灾难性的转向问题以至于让我不得不重新评估其作品是否具备可玩性，在当我需要转大弯时转速非常缓慢，而在需要转小弯时会突然猛地给玩家转个大弯，在有的时候我已经完全松开了转弯键，但向前开还是会猛地转个大弯，无论是在开放世界游戏还是在专业的赛车游戏的领域中很难见到诸如此类大胆的创新想法，而该创意对于笔者孤陋寡闻的游戏理解而言实在是难以苟同。

但就仅此而已吗？并非如此，游戏的键位设置也是体验非常糟糕的一环，在加载界面或部分游戏界面中，回车键是直接切换全屏or窗口的，是否选现是而在设置中，QE键位左右切换没问题，OK很符合逻辑合理，那awsd键位应该是去选择？NO！你要用小键盘一旁的方向键去选择设置，甚至不支持去改相关的操控键位，而且这并不是最糟糕的，最糟糕的是游戏不支持鼠标，只能用键盘操控。

当然，游戏也是有不少可圈可点的地方，比如有目共睹的地图场景设计的非常不错，每个年代的地图甚至都能感到发展带来的地形差异化，而同样是这一片土地，历经了60年的磨难和发展，生活一代又一代人，虽然每次走过同样的路，但在不同的年代再走一遍，总能感受到岁月的沧伤。

而游戏最好的一点就在于可以在方向键随时切换视角，有五种不同游戏视角可以任意切换，包括第一人称，本作也因为上述的原因，以至于让我第一人称的游戏体验比第三人称要好许多，但和同类型的游戏相比较，体验方面还是非常容易让人诟病的。

体验方面也包括与人机队友竞速，在许多作品中人机队友一般都会将能力设置的参差不齐，营造出差异化增强竞技性，而在本作中的人机玩家对于玩家而言非常的不友好，是的，基本都是赛车天才，转弯整整齐齐没有容错，一切都是按照规划好的路径行走不会有变故，在不同地图上的人机玩家都显现出不同的区别，有的甚至像是帕金森患者在与你玩碰碰车，而有的赛车严重怀疑是非法改装车，一路又稳又快。

综上种种因素，《Formula Legends》或许应该是一款优秀的好游戏，但因为过于有创新性的操控手感让我不得不放弃深入体验游戏，我能看到游戏除了故事模式外还有许多自定义比赛和冠军比赛可以体验，但说真的都是如此统一的原因导致差评，那么就应该去慎重考虑，如果能接受这些问题，那么这就是一款好游戏。

Formula Legends es un homenaje total a la historia de la Fórmula 1 que sitúa al jugador en las diferentes décadas que han marcado un antes y un después en este deporte. Desde finales de los 60 hasta la era actual, pasaremos por las diferentes escuderías (que son ficticias pero a la vez reconocibles por su decoración, colores y nombre similar al real) y por circuitos tan emblemáticos como Spa-Francochamps, Monza, Mónaco o Nürburgring entre otros.

Muchos de estos trazados tienen varias versiones, dependiendo de la década en la que se ambienten. Así pues, encontraremos versiones clásicas, retro y modernas de un mismo circuito. Cabe destacar que las pistas son muy similares a las reales, se puede decir que son una re-imaginación de las mismas y que sin ser idénticas, transmiten la sensación de estar pilotando en ese trazado en cuestión.

Como os podéis imaginar, los pilotos tampoco tienen los nombres reales, pero debo decir que me hace gracia ver sus nombres ficticios, así pues, podremos competir contra Ferdinando Alfonso, Mike Shoemaker, Miki Laura o Alain Proust.

Formula Legends es uno de esos juegos que, cuando entras, sabes que vas a echar “solo una carrera” y al final te has hecho medio campeonato. La sensación de ir pasando por distintas décadas de la F1, con coches y circuitos que cambian de aspecto y de comportamiento, hace que cada temporada se sienta distinta y muy fresca. Notas que hay cariño por el detalle: el sonido, la estética retro y la forma en la que evoluciona cada trazado le dan mucha personalidad al juego.​​
No es perfecto: se le ven cosillas en la IA y a veces el manejo puede sentirse un poco impredecible, pero precisamente por eso se nota que tiene mucho margen para crecer. Lo que más convence a la hora de recomendarlo es que ya se habla de él como un juego con recorrido, con actualizaciones que van puliendo la jugabilidad y abriendo el camino a más contenido. Si te gusta trastear, el potencial con mods y ajustes personalizados es enorme, así que da la sensación de ser un proyecto vivo, de esos que dentro de un año pueden estar bastante por encima de cómo salieron.
